title: Activepieces vs Zapier Pricing for Self-Hosted Teams
summary: Activepieces vs Zapier pricing shows Activepieces at $0–$200/month with $0.007 per extra credit, letting you compare total costs across platforms.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is there a free plan for both vendors?


Yes, both vendors publish a free plan, but they count usage differently: one meters in credits (1,000 a month on Free) and Zapier in tasks (100 a month on Free).


Compare the two free allowances by running your own workflow through each counting method, because the same automation can consume very different amounts under each.


The credit-based vendor also has a free Community Edition for self-hosting, with an MIT-licensed core, which Zapier has no equivalent for.


### Can I self-host Zapier?


No. Zapier's a hosted service, and its documentation describes no self-hosted deployment. If your data must stay inside your own network or cloud account, Zapier can't meet that requirement at any plan level.


The alternative can be self-hosted through the free Community Edition, whose core is MIT-licensed. Self-hosted enterprise licences are quoted by sales, and the quote depends on users, credits, deployment and support.


### What happens when I go over my monthly limit?


It depends on the plan and the vendor's metering. On the credit-metered platform, usage beyond the included credits on paid self-serve plans is billed per credit. Zapier's documentation describes its own overage and pause behaviour, which differs between free and paid plans.


Before you commit, check whether a spike causes extra charges or halted workflows. A halted workflow can be the costlier outcome if it drives a customer-facing process.


Does the cheapest plan include SSO? No, not on either vendor's entry tiers. The credit-based vendor includes SSO from its Team plan upward, so Free and Plus don't have it.


Zapier places SSO on higher-tier plans, so confirm the exact tier on its pricing page. If SSO's a hard requirement, price the plan that includes it, not the entry plan.


How often do these prices change? Vendors revise plans, allowances and metering rules without a fixed schedule, so treat any comparison as a snapshot.


Check the live pricing page before you budget. For the self-serve plans, use the vendor's pricing page. For self-hosted enterprise, SSO beyond Team, Ultimate or Embed, use the vendor's sales form.
